content.scenario: Sonia and her builder, Raj, reached a settlement through mediation regarding a dispute over the construction of her house. They want to record the terms of their agreement.
content.outcome: The terms of the agreement between Sonia and Raj shall be reduced to writing and signed by both parties or their authorized representatives, as per the mediation process.

How do I record the terms of an agreement?
